name: Open Data Hub South Tyrol (tourism content API)

provider.name: NOI Techpark / Autonomous Province of Bolzano - South Tyrol

summary: Open API for South Tyrol tourism content (accommodation, events, activities, POIs) and mobility time series, keyless.
description: The Content API at tourism.api.opendatahub.com serves tourism entities such as accommodations (16,193 at check), events, points of interest and gastronomy, with filtering, sorting and several output formats. A separate Time Series API serves mobility and environment measurements from stations and sensors. An OpenAPI 3 spec is published.

auth.notes: Anonymous reads work; registered users get larger quotas.

rate_limit.summary: Unregistered without a referrer: 10 requests per second per IP and query path, and 5 days of historical time-series data; with a Referer header: 20 per second and 100 days (quota docs).

license.name: Per record: see LicenseInfo (CC0, CC BY-SA and others)

coverage.geographic: South Tyrol, Italy (and neighbouring regions for some feeds)
coverage.temporal: current content; time series reach back by quota

agent_notes: Every Content API item carries a LicenseInfo block, so read it per record. Pagination is pagesize (max 1000) and pagenumber. Entities are very large JSON objects: use the fields parameter to cut them. Send a Referer header to double the anonymous rate and extend the time-series history window.
caveats: Licences differ per record (CC0, CC BY-SA, proprietary closed fields); ClosedData true means the record is not open.
Response headers carry x-rate-limit-limit: 10 for anonymous callers; the docs name two APIs (Content and Time Series) with the same quota rules.
The base URL covers the Content (tourism) API only; the mobility Time Series API lives on a different host described in the docs.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
